subject.title: feat(plugins): expose resolved agentId on plugin command context

question: Should `ctx.agentId` be accepted as public Plugin SDK command-context API with resolver-backed semantics for command handlers?
rationale: This changes a third-party plugin contract; green tests can prove the plumbing, but they cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants this API shape and documentation obligation.

options.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
options.body: Approve the optional resolved-agent command-context field, add the command-author docs note, refresh against current main, and merge after normal checks stay green.

options.title: Decline the context expansion
options.body: Close this PR and keep command authors on existing session key and runtime APIs until a different SDK contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
recommendation.body: Approve the optional resolved-agent command-context field, add the command-author docs note, refresh against current main, and merge after normal checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent plugin command session identity contract and are the clearest history signal for this command-context API decision.
